title: Agentic Ontology of Work (AOW)
description:
A platform-agnostic semantic model for intelligent, autonomous, and governed enterprise work: 25 classes and 33 relationships across four layers (Perception, Cognition, Execution, Assurance), including a five-level Assurance Level scale for governed autonomy.

Published as a whitepaper and as an OWL 2 ontology with a JSON-LD context, SHACL shapes, JSON Schemas, SPARQL queries for explainability and oversight checks, and validated examples in insurance, banking, healthcare, the public sector, and retail.

Companion to the SOA-to-Agentic AI Terminology Mapping (doi:10.5281/zenodo.21823088).
